prompt: Amy, an IT security expert, wants to enhance the security of her OpenSSH server by ensuring that it does not use version 1 of the SSH protocol. Which directive should she modify in the OpenSSH configuration file?
explanation: The directive Protocol in the /etc/ssh/sshd_config file specifies the version of the SSH protocol the server should use. By setting it to Protocol 2, Amy ensures that only version 2 of the SSH protocol is used, which is more secure than version 1.
